talk.title: Starting the conversation
talk.description: How you like to bring up intimacy, find the words and hear each other.
talk.followUp: What helps you say something that feels hard to put into words?
prompts: Choosing a time to talk
Would you like to pick a quiet time in advance to talk about intimacy?
choosing a quiet time to talk about intimacy
Starting with a note
If a topic felt hard to say out loud, would writing your partner a note feel comfortable?
starting with a note when something feels hard to say aloud
Naming what feels good
Would you enjoy opening a conversation by naming one thing you already enjoy together?
telling a partner one thing I already enjoy about our time together
Talking side by side
Would talking during a walk feel easier than sitting face to face?
talking side by side on a walk
Asking with an example
Would a scene from a book or film help you put a personal preference into words?
using a scene from a book or film to explain what I like
Choosing words for your body
Would you like to tell a partner which words for your body feel comfortable to hear?
telling a partner which words for my body feel comfortable
Hearing their own words
After you share a wish, would you like a partner to say what they understood in their own words?
hearing a partner put what I’ve shared into their own words
Coming back to a question
Would it suit you to take a question away and return to it another day?
taking time to think before coming back to a question

talk.title: Affection and closeness
talk.description: The small gestures, kinds of touch and shared moments that feel intimate to you.
talk.followUp: Which small gesture makes you feel especially close to me?
prompts: Being held
Would being held after a long day feel like a welcome form of closeness?
being held after a long day
Initiating affectionate touch
Would you enjoy offering your hand as an invitation to be physically close?
offering my hand when I want to be close
Companionable silence
Does spending time quietly together, each absorbed in your own thing, feel intimate to you?
spending time quietly together while we each do our own thing
Playful affection
Would sharing an inside joke or a silly pet name make you feel close?
sharing an inside joke or a silly pet name
Being noticed
Would it feel affectionate if a partner remembered a detail you mentioned in passing?
having a partner remember a small detail I mentioned
Saying what you appreciate
Would you enjoy telling a partner one particular thing you appreciate about them?
telling a partner something specific I appreciate about them
Affectionate eye contact
How would a moment of unhurried eye contact with someone you trust feel to you?
sharing unhurried eye contact with someone I trust
A shared outing
Would making time for a little adventure together feel like an expression of affection?
making time for a little adventure together

talk.title: Desire and pace
talk.description: What sparks your interest, how you initiate and how much time you like.
talk.followUp: How do you like to be invited, and how much time do you like to decide?
prompts: A direct invitation
Would you like a partner to ask plainly when they’re interested in being intimate?
hearing a partner ask me directly about being intimate
Making the first move
How do you feel about being the one to initiate closeness?
being the one to invite a partner closer
Anticipation
Would you enjoy planning a date together and looking forward to intimacy ahead of time?
planning a date together and enjoying the anticipation
Spontaneous invitations
Would a spur-of-the-moment invitation to be close appeal to you on an ordinary day?
getting a spontaneous invitation to be close
Time to warm up
Would you enjoy easing into closeness slowly and discovering whether desire follows?
easing into closeness and seeing whether desire follows
Affection on its own
Would it appeal to you to plan an affectionate evening with an agreement to keep it nonsexual?
planning an affectionate evening we agree to keep nonsexual
Trying something unfamiliar
If you weren’t sure whether a new idea would appeal to you, would you enjoy exploring it at your own pace?
exploring an unfamiliar idea at my own pace
Keeping a fantasy imaginary
Would you enjoy sharing a fantasy that you want to keep entirely in your imagination?
sharing a fantasy I want to keep imaginary

talk.title: Pleasure, comfort & feedback
talk.description: Find words for what feels good, how you like to give feedback and what helps you feel at ease.
talk.followUp: If something feels just right, how would you like to tell me?
prompts: Showing a preferred touch
Would you enjoy showing a partner a touch you like by demonstrating it on your own hand?
showing a partner a touch I like on my own hand
Asking for more of the same
When a touch feels good, would saying “just like that” feel natural to you?
saying “just like that” when a touch feels good
Choosing between two options
Would a choice like “lighter or the same?” make it easier to give feedback in the moment?
giving feedback by choosing between two options
Inviting touch in a familiar spot
Would it feel good to invite a partner to touch a place you already find comforting, such as your shoulders?
inviting a partner to touch a place I already find comforting
Arranging a comfortable position
Would you like a little time to get comfortable with cushions or supports before settling in together?
taking time to get comfortable with cushions or supports
Closeness through voice alone
Would hearing a partner speak to you with their full attention feel intimate on a day you want no touch?
feeling close through a partner’s voice on a day I want no touch
Pleasure without a planned outcome
Would you enjoy an intimate experience with no particular goal beyond noticing what feels good?
enjoying what feels good without aiming for a particular outcome
Exploring pleasure on your own
Would you enjoy discovering on your own what feels pleasant before you consider sharing it with someone?
discovering on my own what feels pleasant to me

talk.title: Expressing boundaries
talk.description: Ways to express a limit, ask for something different or sit with uncertainty.
talk.followUp: How would you like us to respond when one of us names a limit?
prompts: A written boundaries list
Would you like to put a few personal limits in writing before talking them through?
writing down a few limits before talking them through
A short answer
When you decline an invitation, would a simple “that’s off limits for me” suit your style?
using a brief phrase to decline an invitation
Offering an alternative
When one idea doesn’t appeal, would you enjoy suggesting something else you might both like?
suggesting an alternative when an idea doesn’t appeal
A list of open questions
Would you like a separate place for topics you’re curious to discuss before deciding how you feel?
keeping a list of things I want to talk through before deciding
Using an “only if” phrase
When an idea appeals only in a particular setting, would a phrase like “only if we’re at home” fit your style?
saying “only if” when a particular setting matters to me
Practising a boundary phrase
Would you like to rehearse a sentence for speaking up before you need it in the moment?
rehearsing a way to speak up before I need it
A fresh conversation about a limit
If one of your own limits changes, would you like to bring it up yourself at a time you choose?
bringing up a change in one of my own limits when I’m ready
A private pause signal
Would you like a discreet signal to tell your partner that a personal conversation can wait until you’re alone?
using a private signal to save a conversation for later

talk.title: Privacy and digital intimacy
talk.description: Decide what has a place on a screen, what stays private and when messages are welcome.
talk.followUp: What would you want us to agree stays private?
prompts: A neutral text to check for privacy
Once you’ve agreed you both welcome intimate messages, would a neutral “Is this a private moment?” text suit you?
using a neutral text to check for privacy before an intimate exchange we both welcome
Flirting by text
Would you enjoy a flirtatious exchange by text with a partner who has opted in?
flirting by text with a partner who welcomes it
A private video date
Would a planned, private video date feel like a way to be close when you’re apart?
planning a private video date when we’re apart
Keeping intimacy in person
Would it suit you to reserve intimate conversation for times you’re physically together?
keeping intimate conversations for times we’re together in person
Keeping phones away
How would you feel about putting phones in another room during intimate time together?
putting phones in another room during intimate time
Keeping relationship updates offline
Would you enjoy keeping updates about your relationship off social media altogether?
keeping updates about our relationship off social media
Choosing a message window
Would you like to choose times when intimate messages are welcome, such as after work?
choosing when intimate messages are welcome
Keeping an agreed message as a memento
If everyone involved explicitly agreed to keep a particular intimate message, would keeping it appeal to you?
keeping a particular intimate message with everyone’s explicit agreement

talk.title: Relationship agreements
talk.description: Explore exclusivity, openness and what you might agree to with informed, consenting adult partners.
talk.followUp: What would feel right as an agreement, and what would you prefer to keep in imagination?
prompts: Sexual exclusivity
Would a relationship in which you and one partner both choose sexual exclusivity appeal to you?
choosing sexual exclusivity together with one partner
Openness in imagination
Would you enjoy imagining having more than one partner while keeping your actual relationship exclusive?
imagining more than one partner while keeping my relationship exclusive
An open sexual relationship
Would a relationship that allows other sexual partners appeal to you if everyone involved knew and agreed?
having an open sexual relationship with everyone’s knowledge and agreement
Multiple romantic relationships
With everyone’s knowledge and agreement, would you want room to build romantic relationships with more than one person?
building more than one romantic relationship with everyone’s knowledge and agreement
Room for flirting
Would you enjoy an agreement that leaves room to flirt with other interested adults?
leaving room in our agreement to flirt with other interested adults
Reserved time together
Would setting aside a regular evening for a particular relationship help it feel cared for?
setting aside a regular evening for one relationship
Scheduled agreement check-ins
Would choosing a time each season to talk about how your agreements feel suit you?
checking in each season about how our agreements feel
Hearing about other dates
If everyone agreed on what could be shared, would hearing about a partner’s other dates appeal to you?
hearing about a partner’s other dates within privacy limits everyone agreed to

talk.title: Reconnecting
talk.description: What helps after an awkward moment, a difference in desire or time apart.
talk.followUp: What helps you feel close again after an awkward moment?
prompts: Reconnecting through everyday affection
After a busy week apart, would a small affectionate gesture help you find your way back to each other?
reconnecting through a small gesture of affection after time apart
Laughing together
If something feels awkward, would sharing a laugh help you feel close again?
sharing a laugh after an awkward moment
Hearing reassurance
If you and a partner want different things that day, would hearing that their affection hasn’t changed feel good?
hearing reassurance when we want different things that day
Asking to be heard
After a misunderstanding, would you like to ask a partner to listen before suggesting solutions?
asking a partner to listen before offering solutions after a misunderstanding
Naming the impact
If a comment lands badly, would telling your partner what it brought up for you help you reconnect?
explaining how a hurtful comment landed for me
A concrete change
After talking through a difficult experience, would choosing one small change for next time help?
choosing one small change together after a difficult experience
Closeness at a distance
When you’re apart, would swapping short voice messages feel like an intimate way to reconnect?
swapping short voice messages when we’re apart
An ordinary activity together
After a heavy conversation, would doing something familiar together, like cooking, feel grounding?
doing something familiar together after a heavy conversation

bdsm.title: Power and roles
bdsm.description: Which parts of leading, following and sharing or giving direction appeal to you.
bdsm.followUp: Which decisions would you enjoy making yourself?
prompts: Taking the lead
How would you feel about leading a scene that you and a partner have agreed on together?
taking the lead in a scene we agreed on together
Being guided
How would it feel to let a partner guide a scene within the limits you’ve set together?
having a partner guide a scene within the limits we agreed on
Giving clear directions
Would you enjoy giving a partner a simple direction they’ve asked to receive?
giving a partner a direction they asked to receive
Delegating a choice
Would you enjoy handing one decision, like choosing from two agreed activities, to a partner?
letting a partner choose between activities we agreed on
Encouraging words while leading
Would offering encouragement out loud feel like a natural part of leading a scene?
offering words of encouragement while I lead a scene
Being invited to lead
Would hearing a partner explicitly ask you to take charge add to the appeal of leading?
hearing a partner explicitly invite me to take the lead
Choosing the scope of a role
Would you enjoy leading only one part of a shared experience while your partner directs the rest?
leading one part of a shared experience while a partner leads the rest
Sharing in-scene decisions
How would you feel about choosing each next activity together throughout a scene?
choosing each next activity together throughout a scene

bdsm.title: Switching roles
bdsm.description: When a role fits, when it changes and who you’d like to explore it with.
bdsm.followUp: Is there a role you enjoy imagining, whether or not you ever try it?
prompts: Switching on different days
Would it appeal to you to lead on one occasion and follow on another?
leading on one occasion and following on another
Keeping a familiar role
How would you feel about returning to the same role each time you explore with someone?
returning to the same role each time I explore with someone
Taking turns in one scene
Would you enjoy planning a point in one scene where you and a partner trade roles?
planning a moment to trade roles during a scene
Different roles with different partners
Could you see yourself enjoying different roles with different partners?
taking different roles with different partners
Letting mood guide the role
Would you like to decide which role feels good on the day you meet?
choosing my role according to how I feel that day
Trying a role in imagination
Would you enjoy talking through what the other role might feel like, even if you never try it?
talking through what a different role might feel like
Choosing by activity
Would you like to lead in one activity and follow in another based on what each involves?
choosing whether to lead or follow based on the activity
Exploring without a label
How would it feel to explore different roles without choosing a word like dominant, submissive or switch for yourself?
exploring roles without choosing a label for myself

bdsm.title: Fantasy and role-play
bdsm.description: Explore characters, storytelling and how much structure feels right.
bdsm.followUp: Is there a story you would enjoy simply imagining together?
prompts: Inventing characters together
Would you enjoy making up two adult characters and deciding together how they meet?
inventing two adult characters together and deciding how they meet
A fictional persona
Would playing an adult character quite different from your everyday self appeal to you?
playing an adult character who feels different from my everyday self
A simple premise
How would you feel about choosing a setting and improvising the rest within agreed boundaries?
improvising a story in a setting and within limits we both chose
A rehearsed exchange
Would it appeal to you to agree on a few lines of dialogue in advance?
agreeing on a few lines of dialogue in advance
Costume and atmosphere
Would a change of clothes or a carefully chosen setting help you enjoy a role?
using clothes or a setting to help me get into character
A caring character
Would you like to play a caring adult character whose part in the story is to welcome and reassure someone?
playing a caring adult character who welcomes and reassures someone
Telling the story together
Would you enjoy describing an imagined scene to each other while staying entirely out of character?
telling an imagined story together while we both stay out of character
A recurring storyline
Would you like to return to the same fictional characters over several occasions and see how their story develops?
returning to the same characters to see how their story develops

bdsm.title: Restraint and freedom of movement
bdsm.description: Consider the active role, the receiving role and the meaning of restraint to you.
bdsm.followUp: What appeals to you in imagination, and what would you leave there?
prompts: Taking the lead with restraint
If a partner expressed interest in consensual restraint, would you want the active role in that experience?
taking the active role in restraint a partner and I both want

How would you feel about taking the receiving role in an agreed restraint scene?
being restrained in a scene we both agreed on

Would an agreed pose or gesture that represents restraint appeal to you while leaving you free to move?
using an agreed gesture to represent restraint while staying free to move
The visual side of bondage
Would the look of bondage interest you as art, even if participation held little appeal?
enjoying the look of bondage as art
Restraint in fiction
Would you enjoy exploring restraint as a theme in a story you make up together?
exploring restraint in a story we make up together
Giving the opening cue
In the receiving role, would you enjoy giving the opening cue once everyone is ready for a planned scene?
giving the opening cue from the receiving role once everyone is ready
The feeling of stillness
Does a quiet moment of chosen stillness appeal to you as the focus of a scene?
making a moment of chosen stillness the focus of a scene
Freedom to move throughout
Would you like to build a whole scene around having complete freedom of movement?
staying free to move throughout a scene

bdsm.title: Sensation and the senses
bdsm.description: Explore texture, rhythm, sound and scent from the giving and receiving sides.
bdsm.followUp: Which sounds, textures or rhythms are comfortable for you?
prompts: Exploring texture
Would you enjoy making the feel of different soft fabrics the focus of a scene?
exploring the feel of different soft fabrics

Does choosing sensations for a partner from options they’ve requested sound appealing?
choosing sensations from options a partner has asked for
Receiving sensation
Would you enjoy being on the receiving side while a partner follows your stated preferences?
receiving sensations that follow the preferences I’ve shared
A predictable rhythm
Would a steady, predictable rhythm help you settle into a sensory experience?
settling into a steady, predictable rhythm
An element of surprise
Would you enjoy a surprise picked from a small set of sensations you’ve already approved?
being surprised by a sensation from a set I’ve already agreed to
Sound as the focus
How would you feel about building an experience around music or a partner’s voice?
building an experience around music or a partner’s voice
Scent as part of a scene
Would an agreed scent, such as a familiar fragrance, help set the atmosphere for you?
choosing a familiar scent together to set the atmosphere
Describing a sensation
Would you enjoy putting a sensation into words while it’s happening and hearing what your partner notices?
describing a sensation as it happens and hearing what my partner notices

bdsm.title: Rituals and recognition
bdsm.description: How words, routines and symbols might give a shared dynamic meaning.
bdsm.followUp: Is there a word or gesture that would feel meaningful to you?

Would a shared phrase marking the start of a scene feel meaningful to you?
using a shared phrase to mark the start of a scene

How would you feel about using a name or title you both chose for a role?
using a name or title we chose together for a role
A gesture of greeting
Would learning a special gesture to greet your partner in role feel meaningful?

A regular occasion
Would setting aside a particular evening for your dynamic make it feel more special?
setting aside a particular evening for our shared dynamic
A playful rule
Would a made-up rule, chosen together for one scene, add to the fun?
playing with a made-up rule we chose together for one scene
A private symbol
Would a small private symbol that reminds you of your shared dynamic appeal to you?
having a small private symbol of our shared dynamic
An everyday ritual
Would you enjoy carrying one agreed ritual into everyday life, like a particular greeting?
bringing an agreed ritual into everyday life
Keeping roles within the scene
Would it suit you to have all role-specific names and routines end with the scene?
keeping role-specific names and routines within the scene

bdsm.title: Giving and receiving service

offering a small task as part of a role I chose

having a partner prepare something for me as part of their chosen role

inventing a gesture of service around something a partner likes

doing a small ceremonial task for its symbolic meaning
An everyday act of care
Would giving an ordinary task, such as making tea, a special meaning within a scene appeal to you?
giving an everyday task special meaning within a scene
Accepting service without directing it
Would you enjoy receiving a gesture that a partner plans and carries out in their own way?
receiving a gesture of service a partner plans in their own way

Would you like to take turns doing something meaningful for one another as equals?
taking turns doing something meaningful for each other as equals

bdsm.title: Playful challenge and praise

playing a defiant character in a script we both chose

being teased about a fictional rivalry we invented together

trying a friendly contest with low stakes

Would you enjoy a game where you and a partner work toward the same playful goal?
working with a partner toward the same playful goal
Receiving praise
Would hearing a partner praise one particular thing you did during a scene feel good?
hearing praise for something specific I did in a scene
Giving praise
Would you enjoy letting a partner know, in the moment, exactly what you appreciated?
telling a partner in the moment exactly what I appreciated
Praise about effort
How would praise about the effort you put into a role feel, even when things turn out differently than planned?
hearing praise for the effort I put into a role
A chosen reward
Would adding a symbolic reward you picked together, like choosing the next game, make a challenge more enjoyable?
adding a symbolic reward we chose together to a playful challenge

bdsm.title: Intensity and impact

talking about what consensual impact play means to a partner
Impact in fantasy
Does a fictional scene involving consensual impact interest you as something to imagine?
imagining a fictional scene involving consensual impact
Receiving impact
If you and a partner both specifically wanted to explore consensual impact, would the receiving role appeal to you?
receiving impact in a scene we both specifically want
Giving impact
Would taking the giving role in mutually desired impact play interest you?
taking the giving role in impact play we both want

If you explored impact, would you be interested in a scene that stays low in intensity throughout?
keeping an agreed impact scene low in intensity throughout
An intense sensation
Does the receiving side of a stronger physical sensation you’ve chosen appeal to you?
receiving a stronger physical sensation I’ve chosen

Regardless of how you feel about intense sensations, how would you feel about seeing temporary marks on your own skin after an agreed scene?
seeing temporary marks on my own skin after an agreed scene
Emotional intensity
Would you enjoy a scene built around anticipation and emotional intensity while keeping physical sensation gentle?
exploring emotional intensity while keeping physical sensations gentle

bdsm.title: Language & tone
bdsm.description: Explore the words you might hear or say in a scene where everyone has agreed on the language.
bdsm.followUp: Which words or tones belong only in fiction for you, and which feel welcome in person?
prompts: A matter-of-fact voice
Would a partner speaking in a level, matter-of-fact voice during a scene appeal to you?
hearing a partner use a level, matter-of-fact voice in a scene

Would you enjoy giving your own voice a dramatic, larger-than-life quality in a role?
using a dramatic voice when I’m playing a character

addressing each other in deliberately formal language for a scene

hearing direct sexual language in words we chose together
Humiliation as a fictional theme
Would a story about adults who choose a humiliating role dynamic interest you as fiction?
reading fiction about adults who choose a humiliating role dynamic

hearing a pretend put-down I personally chose for a scene
Speaking a chosen put-down in role
Would saying a pretend put-down appeal to you if a partner chose the words and asked to hear them in role?
saying a pretend put-down a partner specifically asked to hear in role

Would a mostly quiet scene appeal to you, with room for the check-ins you’ve agreed on?
sharing a mostly quiet scene with room for our agreed check-ins

bdsm.title: Watching and being seen
bdsm.description: All scenarios here are private and involve only adults who agreed to participate or observe.
bdsm.followUp: Would this feel different in imagination than it would with an invited observer?
prompts: An audience of one
Would you enjoy being seen by one invited partner during a private scene?
being seen by one invited partner during a private scene

Would watching an adult partner perform a scene especially for you appeal to you?
watching an adult partner perform a private scene especially for me
Watching together
Would you enjoy sitting alongside a partner as invited observers at a private adult performance?
watching a private adult performance together as invited observers
A small invited audience
Would being seen by a small group of invited, consenting adults feel appealing to you?
being seen by a small group of invited, consenting adults in private
Switching who watches

taking turns performing and watching with a consenting partner in private
Feedback from an observer

asking an invited observer what they appreciated after a private performance
Imagining an audience
Would you like to imagine an audience while keeping the actual experience just between you and a partner?
imagining an audience while keeping the actual experience just between us

choosing exactly what an invited partner sees in a private performance

bdsm.title: Privacy & community

reading personal accounts other adults chose to publish

Would you like to ask an educational question under a pseudonym in a moderated adults-only discussion?
asking an educational question under a pseudonym in a moderated adult discussion

meeting other adults at a kink gathering devoted to conversation

attending a community gathering with a trusted adult friend

listening at an adults-only workshop where every exercise is optional

joining a discussion with adults who share my experiences or access needs
Keeping your own community name private

using a community name separate from my everyday name
A one-to-one peer conversation
Would you like to trade reading recommendations privately with another adult who welcomes that conversation?
exchanging reading recommendations privately with another interested adult

planning a scene by each choosing from a short menu of activities

choosing the lighting, sound or room setup myself

changing just one thing in an otherwise familiar scene

using plain words to check in during a scene

Would using a shared word like green, yellow or red feel natural for communicating how a scene is going?
using a colour word to say how a scene is going

using an agreed gesture when I want to pause or stop

planning a time to pause and talk during a scene

stepping out of our roles to talk through a change of plan

bdsm.title: Aftercare

sitting quietly together after a scene

having a little time to myself right after a scene

being offered a hug or a hand to hold after a scene

having a familiar comfort waiting for me afterward

hearing my everyday name as I come out of a role
A direct question after leading

having a partner ask what I need after I’ve led a scene
Sharing a highlight
Would you enjoy each naming a moment you appreciated once a scene is over?
